summary: Enabled a persistent nftables host firewall on node1. SSH/TCP 22 and TCP 8080 are permitted; unrelated inbound traffic is explicitly rejected. Configuration survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Configured stateful input filtering, loopback and control-traffic handling, TCP 22/8080 acceptance, and terminal inbound rejection.
Enabled nftables in the default boot runlevel.
Verified behavior before and after reboot using live connection probes and nftables counters.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed and services recovered.

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, live probes passed on TCP 22 and 8080, TCP 8081 was rejected, and nftables accept/reject counters incremented.
Captured boot ID e7fda9e7-7c09-49c6-9538-3af84d4503ad, running nftables and sshd, boot enablement, effective rules, and SSH reachability.
The safe reboot was scheduled and acknowledged before disconnection.
Post-restart boot ID was 1d46db8a-98d4-4cc5-87f4-d67adf3904ac, differing from the pre-restart identity.

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart firewall and service recovery
evidence.summary: nftables and sshd recovered as started and enabled; the persisted rules loaded successfully and all allow/reject probes behaved as required.
